reviews.text: Came for the self service wash 12/10! I did the upgraded wash for only an extra $5 so $25 total and it was so nice. Super easy and they have everything you need and more. Will be coming back here whenever my dog needs a wash. Honestly I think he smells better than when I take him to the groomers! And the guy walked me through how to do everything and was super nice and helpful!!
the sweetest staff!

I went in just to browse but ended up buying supplies for both my cat and fish tank. The staff didn’t hover or pressure me, which I liked. One aquarium product I picked needed extra explanation, and they took time to walk me through it. The only downside was a bit of waiting during billing because a few customers were ahead. Nothing serious, just slightly slow. The shop has a comfortable feel, and it’s easy to ask questions without feeling rushed.
Great atmosphere

Absolutely amazing store! The employee there gave me a tour when I told him it was my first time in there, showed me all of the great brands in the store, and was super nice and friendly! I will definitely be coming back here!
Although the dogs aren't thrilled, we are! Super helpful staff.
Very helpful employees, I was recommended some shampoo for my English Bulldog and I am very pleased with it. The scent is amazing and he still smells good a day after, like he just had a bath!

Kelsey was not only incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, but she also went above and beyond to care for my anxious border collie who absolutely hates the blow dryer. She took the time to soothe him with peanut butter pup ice cream and even shared helpful tips on how to gently reintroduce him to the blow dryer at home. Acts of kindness like this truly stand out. I’m so grateful for the level of care and compassion — will continue to be loyal customer!

In 2021, we brought our dog home from the shelter and made our first stop at Uptown Pup to pick up all the essentials (and a few not-so-essentials—the toys were impossible to resist!). From that very first visit, we knew we’d be regulars.

We’re incredibly grateful for the love and care our dog receives every time we walk through the door. Lauren has generously shared her knowledge with us, and the entire Uptown Pup team brightens our day with every visit.

The events Lauren organizes are not only a blast to attend, but they also foster a sense of community and support other local businesses, which is something we truly value.

We feel so lucky to have Uptown Pup in our lives and couldn’t recommend them more highly! Thanks for all you do, Lauren & Kevin!!
Lovely charm
I love this place! They have great quality products and I can tell the staff truly love working with pups. Found my new favorite pet store!

This is one of my fav stores in Dallas!! I always rave about Uptown Pup to any of my friends with pets.

The owners and workers are all so incredibly helpful and friendly— you can tell they genuinely love what they do and are always so excited to help me pick out a new bone, toy, or even collar for my pup.

We also rented the yard for our dog’s birthday which was a HUGE hit and they went above & beyond helping us make the day great. They provided toys & goodie bags for all guests which was so thoughtful.

Highly recommend shopping here for your dog or stopping by any of the events they do!

THIS PLACE IS INCREDIBLE!!! It was the first time giving my new dog a bath, they made us (Happy and I) feel so welcome. The owner/staff were incredibly informative on their process for baths, everything was incredibly clean, they even gave Happy a new collar for FREE because the one that he had from the shelter was old and just not a good fit for him anymore. Not saying you will get a free collar lol, but the experience and overall customer satisfaction will be impeccable, so I highly recommend you take your fur babies here. I’m keeping by business with Uptown Pup for everything Happy needs. If I could give them 20 stars I would. ❤️🐕
